_id.description: Unique identifier of the document. Pattern: CERT-<recordNo>

recordNo.description: Business identifier of the document, readable by people and unique within the site

siteId.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_site._id: the site the document belongs to

siteName.description: Display value of the site, copied from u_mes_mast_site.name

userName.description: Display value of userId, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

skillName.description: Display value of skillId, copied from u_mes_mast_skill.name

level.description: Level number on the scale of the parent record

awardedAt.description: Date and time when the record was awarded

validFrom.description: Valid from (calendar date, stored as the start of that day in IST converted to UTC)

validTo.description: Valid to (calendar date, stored as the start of that day in IST converted to UTC)

assessorUserName.description: Display value of assessorUserId, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

evidenceControlledDocumentId.description: Reference to u_mes_syst_controlledDocument._id: evidence controlled document

evidenceControlledDocumentName.description: Display value of evidenceControlledDocumentId, copied from u_mes_syst_controlledDocument.title

revokedAt.description: Date and time when the record was revoked

status.description: Primary lifecycle state of the document

schemaVersion.description: Version of this collection's document structure, starting at 1

createdAt.description: Date and time the document was created

createdById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that created the document

createdBy.description: Display name of the creator, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName

updatedAt.description: Date and time of the most recent update

updatedById.description: Reference to u_mes_mast_user._id: user or process that last updated the document

updatedBy.description: Display name of the last updater, copied from u_mes_mast_user.fullName
